text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Shortly after the Takarazuka Kinen came to an end,
summer training camp began once again this year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Air Groove after finishing
her rematch against Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We will now conduct roll call.
Everyone, assemble at the gathering point!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once again, I served as a supervisor for the training camp on behalf of the student council.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Sapporo Kinen ahead—her chance at a comeback during this camp—
she seems as highly motivated as usual on the surface,
with no apparent change in demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might not have realized it herself,
but there were times when a distinctly somber expression crossed her face.
What's more, she had become considerably quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something like this would have been
unthinkable for the girl she used to be.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Suffering in deep anxiety, under a lingering dark cloud, as it were.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen the other day...
It seems to have taken quite a toll on her."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel just as pained for her as anyone else.
Surely there must be some words of comfort I can offer her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You are the only one
who can truly help her stand on her feet again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Because you are her...
one and only Trainer, after all."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...If you ever need my help,
don't hesitate to ask."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What kind of words could I possibly offer to Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on the days I had spent with her so far,
I decided to search for something I could do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, with an eye toward the autumn GⅠ campaign,
I'd like to let her catch her stride in the GⅡ Sapporo Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, no matter what...
Let's bring Air Groove back to life!"
